Sam: Quick heads-up — ran a focused bakeoff combining SmoothQuant + activation-aware scaling on AWQ and GPTQ for the 32k long-context build (small model family). Trying to surface the accuracy deltas and deployment perf profile. TL;DR: AWQ+SQ looks promising, GPTQ has larger quality hit on long-context LRA tasks.
Julia: nice, can you share the eval harness and which tasks you used?
Sam: used our longctx eval harness: `eval_longctx.py` with datasets: codechat-ctx, longqa-16k, math-32k subsets, and some LRA-style token-recall probes. Command: `python eval_longctx.py --model checkpoints/mixv2 --quant awq --smoothquant true --ctx 32768 --batch 1`
Mike: any OOMs or KV-cache regressions? memory numbers?
Sam: no OOMs on 80GB A100. KV cache steady; per-shard KV mem ~9.2GB for AWQ+SQ vs 11.6GB fp16 baseline. Throughput down ~12% p50 tokens/s.
Anya: what about accuracy numbers? small table or diff?
Sam: pasted a quick summary below (delta = quant - fp16 baseline):
```
longqa-16k: AWQ+SQ delta: -0.7% accuracy, GPTQ delta: -3.8%
codechat-ctx (recall@20): AWQ+SQ delta: -0.9%, GPTQ delta: -4.1%
math-32k (pass@1): AWQ+SQ delta: -1.1%, GPTQ delta: -5.2%
```
Sam: also tried FP8 kernel (mixed FP8 activations + AWQ weights) on a small subset — quality similar to AWQ in many cases but had occasional spikes in hallucinations for code tasks, need more runs.
Julia: interesting — do we have per-layer activation scale histograms? maybe activation-aware is missing a few layers for GPTQ path.
Sam: yes, dumped per-layer stats to s3: `s3://redwood-dev/quant/bakeoffs/1792120000/stats.tar.gz`. Quick excerpt: several attention-feedforward layers show 2-3x higher activation variance in long sequences, leading to clipping under GPTQ quantization map.
Mike: can we try hybrid: AWQ for feedforwards + GPTQ for attention, or per-layer mix?
Anya: +1 to hybrid. Also request trying SmoothQuant with per-channel act scaling (instead of global) for the problematic layers. Might reduce the GPTQ delta.
Sam: scheduled a follow-up run: hybrid AWQ(GGUF)/GPTQ(att) + per-channel act-scaling on top 6 ff layers. Will post logs and microbenchmarks when done.
ci-bot: build 1792-quant-bake uploaded, artifacts: `s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/1792-quant-bake/` :white_check_mark:
Julia: feel free to attach the run configs here — we should capture them in the experiment registry. Also decide which variants to push to dedicated for a smoke deployment.
Sam: putting configs inline:
```
quant_config:
  weight_quant: awq
  smoothquant: true
  act_scaling: per_channel
  hybrid_layers: {attention: gptq, feedforward: awq}
  ctx_len: 32768
```
Anya: cool. After the hybrid run, can we run a 1-hour dedicated smoke on a 4-shard pool and measure latency p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens? Ops wants numbers before any rollout.
Sam: yep. I'll kick off hybrid + per-channel act-scaling now. ETA for results ~2.5h. Posting updates here. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
